title: RWB-S6-E6007-APP: the transfer slice has no plan row for its five consumed contracts or the buyer-file delivery, no outbox row although it publishes AccountsTransferred, no transfer operation and no column set to record the transfer
source: Template and Rules v1 R5.4, R5.5, R5.6, R7.2 and R9; split plan slice RWB-S6-E6007-APP; context pack S6 rwb-debtsale (service row, ownership rows, Architecture v5 slides 3, 4, 5, 8 and 13, Temporal and Drools slides 5, 12 and 13); legacy RWB-E6-007; FSD S6 Debt sale v3 A2.11, A1.3, A1.4 and A2.11.4.4; TSD S6 Debt sale v2 T2, T3.1 to T3.3, T4, T5.1, T5.2, T5.3, T6.1 and T-A; Business Rules and Routing Logic v4 rows R-DS-25 and R-DS-29; Recovery Workbench Epics 3 to 8 Specification v3 row FEAT-DBS-11
description: (1) The plan gives H = RWB-S6-E6007-CON, RWB-PLT-E1027-CON and RWB-PLT-N001-CON with C, I and X empty, while the step reads the rwb-case case state, answers the rwb-case case move, reads the rwb-partner buyer organisation, calls the rwb-access authorise contract, reads the rwb-decision package and instructs the rwb-integration buyer-file delivery, so six consumed rows have no plan row. (2) The service owns the topic rwb.debtsale.events.v1 and Architecture v5 gives it the events LotAwarded and AccountsTransferred, yet DP-09 is absent from the pattern set of this key, so the outbox and inbox library RWB-PLT-TE006-CON is absent from the H row, and DP-14 is absent although the event name follows the naming library. (3) DP-16 is absent although Architecture v5 gives rwb-debtsale 'Integration: deliverFile (buyer file)' and the connection matrix gives S6 a Temporal call to P2, so RWB-P2-E1007-CON is absent from the C row. (4) DP-04 is absent although the step evaluates the DEBTSALE route set, so no Drools kit row RWB-PLT-E1072-CON or C row RWB-P7-E1073-CON is held. (5) TSD S6 appendix T-A publishes five operations and none is a transfer operation, while the legacy story lists the award path API-S6-003 and the data room read API-S6-004, which belong to RWB-S6-E6005-APP and RWB-S6-E5026-APP. (6) TSD S6 T5.3 lists LotAwarded alone as a published event and the event catalogue publishes a payload for LotAwarded and none for AccountsTransferred, while the Architecture v5 event row gives both events, so the second event and its payload come from the higher source. (7) TSD S6 T3.1 declares no transfer time and no file reference on debt_sale_account and no column for the delivery reference on debt_sale_lot, so the transfer is recorded on the lot status, the decision record and the event only. (8) R-DS-25 is also owned by the settlement story RWB-S6-E6011-APP, which consumes ProceedsMatched, so the rule and its settled fact appear in two slices of the same key.
evidence: Split plan slice RWB-S6-E6007-APP (C, I and X empty; H = CON, E1027-CON, N001-CON); FSD S6 A2.11.2 step 3 and A2.11.4.4 ('No background event'); TSD S6 T5.1 (INT-25 Debt buyers, Out, File through the data room, Per lot), T5.3 (LotAwarded, Published), T3.1 (debt_sale_lot DF-SAL-020 to DF-SAL-030, debt_sale_account DF-SAL-031 to DF-SAL-037) and T-A.1 (API-S6-001 to API-S6-005); Architecture v5 event row (AccountsTransferred, rwb-debtsale, rwb.debtsale.events.v1, rwb-case and rwb-reporting) and OUT row ('Integration: deliverFile (buyer file)'); context pack connection-matrix row S6 Debt sale (T to P7, T to P5, T E to P8, T to P2); legacy RWB-E6-007 Endpoints and Data tables
proposed: Keep the plan's H, C, I and X rows as they stand; build the step on Day 1 against the six contract fakes; publish AccountsTransferred through the platform outbox and track RWB-PLT-TE006-CON, RWB-PLT-E1047-CON and RWB-P2-E1007-CON as dependencies of the story; serve the transfer element on the answers of API-S6-002 and API-S6-004 and claim no operation; record the transfer on the lot status, the decision record and the event until a column set is agreed; and split R-DS-25 between the settlement step and the release of this step in one saga.

title: RWB-S6-E6007-CON: the transfer element, the AccountsTransferred schema and payload, the buyer-file delivery contract and the consumed operation names have no published baseline
source: Template and Rules v1 R5.4, R5.5, R7.2 and R9; split plan slice RWB-S6-E6007-CON; context pack S6 rwb-debtsale; legacy RWB-E6-007; FSD S6 Debt sale v3 A2.11.2, A2.11.3.1, A2.11.4.4 and Screens; TSD S6 Debt sale v2 T2, T3.1, T3.2, T4, T5.1, T5.2, T5.3, T6.1 and T-A.1 and T-A.2; Business Rules and Routing Logic v4 rows R-DS-25 and R-DS-29
description: (1) No AsyncAPI catalogue publishes the transfer event: TSD S6 T5.3 lists LotAwarded alone, the event catalogue gives a payload for LotAwarded (lotId, buyerId, price) and none for AccountsTransferred, and the Architecture v5 event row gives the event name, the producer, the topic and the consumers only, so the envelope, the key, the subject and the payload properties are fixed by this baseline. (2) TSD S6 T-A publishes no transfer operation and no OpenAPI element of the module, so the transfer element, its required flags and its formats are fixed here and not copied. (3) rwb-integration's deliverFile is named by the Architecture v5 OUT row of rwb-debtsale but its request and response properties, its idempotency rule and its error set are published nowhere, so the consumed row carries the placeholder. (4) No source publishes the operation names of the rwb-case state read and move answer, the rwb-partner buyer read or the rwb-access authorise call. (5) TSD S6 T-A.2 gives error status codes with no message id per condition, so each condition is bound to a message of the legacy and FSD set. (6) debt_sale_account carries no transfer time and no file reference, so the contract declares the decision record and the event as the place where the delivery reference lives. (7) The plan's C, I and X rows of this slice are empty while the contract declares five consumed rows and one delivery activity.
evidence: TSD S6 T-A.1 operations API-S6-001 to API-S6-005 and T-A.2 error lists 401, 403, 404, 409, 422 and 503 without message ids; TSD S6 T3.1 field list; TSD S6 T5.1 INT-25; TSD S6 T5.3 single event row; Architecture v5 OUT row ('TMP Document: data room pack · Decision: child: approval · Integration: deliverFile (buyer file) · Payment: postProceeds') and event row for AccountsTransferred; FSD S6 A2.11.3.1 rule set; legacy RWB-E6-007 Endpoints, Screen and states and Test cases
proposed: Fix the transfer element, the event schema and the delivery row in the baseline review; publish them as one OpenAPI 3.1 fragment and one AsyncAPI document for rwb-debtsale v1; carry the placeholder on every consumed row whose members are not published; and reconcile the baseline with TSD S6 and the event catalogue when their owners publish the names.
